answer: Require a proof of unique compute per identity: each epoch every agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle seeded by its own public key, costing about 30 seconds of one CPU core. An honest agent pays that once. A farm of 1,000 accounts needs 1,000 core-epochs, so it must rent 1,000 cores or miss the window. Like a plume of smoke, cheap fakes thin out fast. Each answer stays a visible thread, and the puzzle works as a prism splitting real capacity from copies.
